primary_gt.response_priority: Prioritize peat-fire haze exposure management and downwind air-quality protection, not rainfall/flood disruption or direct burn-scar response as the main profile.

required_findings.name: dominant_priority_profile
required_findings.expected: compound peat-fire haze response priority, not rainfall/flood or direct burn-scar damage

required_findings.name: mechanism_chain
required_findings.expected: El Nino or drought dryness -> dry peat and fires -> smoke/haze transport -> downwind air-quality exposure

required_findings.name: response_priority
required_findings.expected: haze exposure and air-quality protection calibrated by local population and asset exposure

required_findings.name: overclaim_control
required_findings.expected: avoid exact deaths, PM2.5 dose, economic loss, direct burn-scar severity, and full regional drought reconstruction

reasoning_requirements: Connect drought or El Nino dryness to peat-fire susceptibility.
Treat smoke or haze transport as the dominant impact pathway.
Use local exposure to explain response priority rather than as observed damage.
Reject rainfall/flood disruption and direct burn-scar damage as the main profile.
forbidden_overclaims: exact deaths, hospitalizations, or economic losses
precise PM2.5 concentration or pollution-dose reconstruction
direct burn-scar severity as the central conclusion
full Sumatra/Kalimantan drought reconstruction from the bounded local daily weather point
rainfall or flood disruption as the dominant mechanism

criteria.name: final_answer_and_priority_class
criteria.description: Returns high_priority_compound_peat_fire_haze or an equivalent compact compound peat-fire haze label and assigns priority_class high.
criteria.partial_credit: Gives a fire-haze answer but omits the priority class or uses a nearby but incorrect class such as very_high or moderate.

criteria.name: quantitative_anchors
criteria.description: Uses 2-5 relevant anchors, including several of: 46 weather-analysis days, 15 and 14 dry days, 4-day longest dry run, 84.2 priority index if reported, and local population near 2,750.
criteria.partial_credit: Provides at least one correct anchor but mixes in irrelevant or unsupported numbers.

criteria.name: mechanism_chain
criteria.description: Connects drought or El Nino dryness to dry peat, peat fires, smoke or haze, and downwind air-quality exposure.
criteria.partial_credit: Mentions fires and haze but weakly explains the drought/peat driver or transport pathway.

criteria.name: response_priority_interpretation
criteria.description: States a practical response priority centered on haze exposure management, air-quality protection, and exposed people or infrastructure.
criteria.partial_credit: Gives a generic emergency response statement without tying it to haze exposure.

criteria.name: distractor_rejection
criteria.description: Substantively rejects rainfall/flood disruption, direct burn-scar damage, and catalog-only uncertainty as the main framing.
criteria.partial_credit: Rejects only one or two distractors or does so without explanation.

criteria.name: overclaim_control
criteria.description: Avoids unsupported exact mortality, hospitalization, economic-loss, PM2.5 dose, climate-attribution, direct burn-scar severity, and full regional drought-reconstruction claims.
criteria.partial_credit: Contains a minor unsupported extension but does not change the main diagnosis.

criteria.name: format_and_clarity
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with the requested keys and concise, internally consistent wording.
criteria.partial_credit: Mostly follows the requested structure but has minor formatting or clarity issues.
